title: Zesty Moroccan Chicken Couscous Royal
description: A citrusy and velvety Moroccan dish featuring horseradish, served over couscous, perfect for a sick day. This low-sodium-friendly recipe is served in a bamboo tray.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the grated horseradish, lemon juice, and salt-free seasoning blend to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the low-sodium chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Prepare the couscous according to package instructions.
To serve, place the cooked couscous on a bamboo tray and top with the chicken and sauce.
